content.value_statement: WooCommerce changes need consistent architecture, tests, documentation, and UI copy. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to review changes against WooCommerce standards.
actual_capabilities: Flags standalone functions where WooCommerce expects class methods.
Checks dependency injection guidance for DI-managed classes.
Reviews public method, hook, and test documentation expectations.
Identifies missing validation before deletion or modification logic.
Checks WooCommerce test naming and test documentation conventions.
Reviews UI copy for sentence case requirements.
limitations: It depends on linked WooCommerce standard skills for complete rules.
It does not execute tests or static analysis tools by itself.
It cannot prove runtime behavior without the reviewed code context.
It focuses on WooCommerce conventions, not general security auditing.

use_cases.title: Pre-merge standards review
use_cases.description: Review a WooCommerce pull request before maintainer approval.

use_cases.title: Contributor self-check
use_cases.description: Check local changes for architecture, documentation, and testing issues.

use_cases.title: UI copy review
use_cases.description: Find title case and sentence case issues in interface text.

prompt_templates.title: Basic standards check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these WooCommerce changes for standards issues. Focus on clear findings with file and line references.

prompt_templates.title: Backend architecture review
prompt_templates.scenario: Review PHP service or class changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this WooCommerce backend change. Check class structure, dependency injection, naming, documentation, and validation rules.

prompt_templates.title: Tests and data integrity review
prompt_templates.scenario: Review changes that include tests or mutations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this WooCommerce change for test conventions and data integrity. Group related issues and explain the expected fix.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced pull request review
prompt_templates.scenario: Full review across backend code, tests, and copy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a WooCommerce code review for this pull request. Cite relevant standards, prioritize critical violations, and provide concise fixes.

output_examples.input: A pull request adds a WooCommerce service class and related tests.
output: Flags direct construction of a managed service.
Notes test naming that does not match project convention.

output_examples.input: A change modifies order deletion logic and admin screen labels.
output: Highlights missing validation before destructive behavior.
Finds title case text that should use sentence case.
Provides a short fix for each issue.

best_practices: Provide the relevant diff and enough surrounding context for each file.
Ask for grouped findings when reviewing a large pull request.
Verify final decisions against the linked WooCommerce standard files.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as a replacement for automated tests.
Do not review unrelated projects with WooCommerce-specific rules.
Do not accept findings without checking the cited code location.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews WooCommerce code for architecture, documentation, testing, validation, and UI copy standards.

faq.question: Does it run test suites?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and findings, but it does not run tools by itself.

faq.question: Can it review non-WooCommerce projects?
faq.answer: It can read them, but the findings are based on WooCommerce rules and may not apply.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the changed files, relevant diff, and the review goal.

faq.question: Does it include all standards?
faq.answer: No. It points reviewers to related WooCommerce skill files for complete standards.
